top_signals.title: Flyers are happier with U.S. airports, despite near record travel levels, J.D. Power report shows
top_signals.summary: Travelers gave higher ratings in part because of the newer gates and terminals many airports have opened in recent years, according to the study.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
